question: A, B, and C can complete a piece of work in 16 days, 24 days, and 32 days respectively. How many days will all three take together to complete the work?
solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 16 days.

B can complete the work in 24 days.

C can complete the work in 32 days.

**Formula Used:**

Work done by A, B, and C together in 1 day = (1/16) + (1/24) + (1/32)

**Calculation:**

Work done by A in 1 day = 1/16

Work done by B in 1 day = 1/24

Work done by C in 1 day = 1/32

⇒ Work done by A, B, and C together in 1 day = (1/16) + (1/24) + (1/32)

⇒ Work done by A, B, and C together in 1 day = (3/48) + (2/48) + (1.5/48)

⇒ Work done by A, B, and C together in 1 day = (6.5/48)

⇒ Work done by A, B, and C together in 1 day = (13/96)

Number of days taken by A, B, and C to complete the work = 1 / (Work done by A, B, and C together in 1 day)

⇒ Number of days taken by A, B, and C to complete the work = 96/13

**All three will take 96/13 days to complete the work.**
